svg.title: Restriction digests: 5-prime, 3-prime, and blunt ends
svg.desc: HindIII: A|AGCTT / TTCGA|A, 5-prime protruding ends. PstI: CTGCA|G / G|ACGTC, 3-prime protruding ends. EcoRV: GAT|ATC / CTA|TAG, blunt ends. Blue and gold identify restriction fragments; both strands preserve antiparallel polarity. Source teaching content: image_010.png.
